text:
maria: Proposed webinar topic: "Serving LLMs at Scale: tradeoffs, observability, and cost ops". Goal: practical playbook + short case study. Thoughts?

ada: love the angle. who do we want as speakers? need someone who can speak to both infra and product impact.

sam: audience should be ML engineers + platform folks. CTA: sign up for a Dedicated trial + evaluation kit.

kevin: can we get a short animation (30s) showing request routing + fallback? would be good in the first 60s.

maria: tentative speakers: prashant (serving runtime deep dive) + laura (customer PM, fintech) for the case study. laura is available mid-April. prashant ok?

prashant: I can do a ~12min segment on kernel selection, batching, and fallback policy examples. will prepare 6 slides max. need SSO access to the slide deck.

ada: run-of-show draft (30m total):
- 0:00–0:02 intro + agenda (host)
- 0:02–0:12 product/ops (prashant): runtime, routing, batching
- 0:12–0:22 customer case study (laura)
- 0:22–0:28 live Q&A (panel)
- 0:28–0:30 CTAs + resources + recording link

sam: strong. add a 60s demo clip (pre-recorded) between prashant and laura to show latency/cost dashboard.

maria: rehearsal plan: dry run (slides + transitions) Tue 14:00 PT, tech check 10m before. Full dress rehearsal Thu 09:00 PT. can everyone make at least one?

kevin: I can do the 10m tech check (slides + stream layout + lower thirds). will upload assets to the folder.

alex: for sales enablement — can we get a short FAQ doc + 3 talk tracks (startup, mid-market, enterprise)? need to route leads: tag = webinar_serving_ops, source = hubspot/form.

maria: yes, we'll wire hubspot with hidden field source=webinar_serving_ops. sam, can you own lead routing mapping to SDR queues?

sam: I will. conversion funnel: registration -> attendance -> engaged (asked Q/A or downloaded kit). route engaged to AE queue, others to nurture. docs: /marketing/ops/webinars/runbooks -> I'll add mapping.

prashant: tech checklist for the stream:
```
- Presenter mics tested on USB/Zoom; backup laptop ready
- Slides exported to PDF as backup
- Pre-recorded demo MP4 uploaded to Vimeo and local copy
- Host account with config for spotlighting speakers
- Recording capture enabled and auto-upload to GDrive
```

maria: Q&A moderation: we'll use Slido for upvoting. kevin, can you design a single slide with resources + links + short lead form QR?

kevin: yep, will share first draft by Mon EOD.

ops-bot: Reminder: webinar license check passed. Max concurrent viewers set to 2k.

ada: promo timeline: week 0 (announcement email + blog), week 1 (reminders + targeted ads), week 2 (day-before + 1h reminder). PR: short bench narrative about 'reducing token cost by 3x with caching & batching'—maria, happy to review copy.

maria: I'll draft both announcement and bench blurb. want to keep numbers conservative; cite 'customer observed' and include methodology note.

alex: for the handout, include runbook snippets for routing policies + code sample for a fallback policy. prashant, can you provide a 10-line example?

prashant: yes — will paste a simple pseudo-config: `route: primary->gpt-q4:80%, fallback->gpt-q4-small:20%` with TTLs and K/V cache settings.

maria: action items:
- prashant: slides + 10-line config example (due Fri)
- laura: case study slide deck + metrics (due Fri)
- kevin: assets + final slide design (Mon)
- sam: hubspot mapping + nurture flow (Mon)
- ada: sign-off on promo copy (Tue)
- maria: draft announcement + bench blurb (Thu)

ada: tiny ask — can we rehearse an emergency fallback: if live demo fails, play pre-recorded demo and move to Qs. everyone confirm they can pivot. :+1:?

maria: confirmed. I'll pin the fallback script in the doc and share the meeting link for rehearsals.

sam: putting a small paid ad budget behind it. will send targeting + creative brief tomorrow.

kevin: uploaded first slide mock v0.1 -> https://drive.company/slides/webinar-serving-v01.png

maria: thanks team — I'll create the registration page and share copy in this thread. closing loop after dress run. :rocket:
